bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to veterans; appropriating money to construct a chapel at a national veterans cemetery.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; FARGO MEMORIAL HONOR GUARD.

$....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of veterans affairs for a grant to Fargo Memorial Honor Guard for construction costs associated with the construction of a chapel, parking lot, and related infrastructure at a veterans national cemetery in North Dakota. This is a onetime appropriation.
